text.p: German mobile phone service provider Mobilcom AG said on Tuesday that it had experienced speedier than expected growth in the first quarter of 1997.
The group said in a regulatory statement that customer numbers increased to 173,942 by the end of March 1997, an increase of 8.3 percent from the figure at the end of 1996.
"The very satisfactory development will have a positive effect on Mobilcom's first quarter earnings which will be presented at the end of April," Mobilcom said.
Mobilcom shares were first listed last month as part of the German bourse's new Neue Markt growth stock market, which provides a platform for innovative young firms to raise capital on the market.
